title: Free Dyslexia Resource Test
markdown:
##### **Dyslexia** is a learning disorder that involves difficulty reading due to problems identifying speech sounds and learning how they relate to letters and words (decoding). Also called reading disability, **dyslexia** affects areas of the brain that process language.

![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/dyslexia-1-728.jpg) ![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/Dyslexia-Facts-2.jpg) ![](http://www.americangroup-international.com/wp-content/uploads/2020/05/slide_3.jpg)
